data_fields.name: power_cooldown_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: power.cooldown, parsed as ms or s (default 0)

data_fields.name: hp_cost
data_fields.donor_constant: power.requires_hp (float, taken as self-damage; sacrifice flag allows lethal)

data_fields.name: summon_cap_count
data_fields.donor_constant: power.spawn_limit count; fixed mode uses it directly, stat mode multiplies it by primary stat / ratio; floor 1

data_fields.name: hit_window_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: cooldown_hit duration per creature (interrupt window after a hit)

data_fields.name: absorb_min_max_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: engine defaults min 0, max 100 percent of the hit

data_fields.name: mp_regen_per_min
data_fields.donor_constant: MP_REGEN stat, applied as stat/60 per second, only while hp > 0

data_fields.name: resting_hp_regen_s
data_fields.donor_constant: enemy out-of-combat full heal time, default 5 s

best_idea: A per-power summon cap (fixed, or scaled by a primary stat with floor 1) checked at cast time, with all of a summoner's minions removed in the same tick the summoner dies, bounds and cleans up many-on-one minion fights.
decision_why: Keep the cap-at-cast and summoner-linked removal shapes; reject the donor's client-only cooldown gate (Frankendom's server must check cost, cooldown and cap on the cast path) and fix the mismatched HP boundary (activate uses >=, checkPowerCost uses <) with one comparison and a delta-time regen.
acceptance: Server test: with 3 live minions of one power, a 4th cast is rejected; killing the summoner removes its 3 minions in the same tick; a hit on a non-poised casting enemy cancels the cast unless the power is flagged preventInterrupt.
